messages:
Marta: Dropped a fresh Figma for an accordion-first roles view + invite quickpath: https://figma.com/file/new-accordion
Owen: Quick thought: accordion items should expose permissions summary in-line, not only in the detail panel
Priya: Agree. For screen readers, each accordion header needs aria-expanded and an aria-controls pointing to the detail region
Caleb: Invite flow: when someone pastes a list of emails, we should tokenise immediately and show inline validation per token
Liz: If tokens have errors, show an inline 'Fix' action next to the token instead of forcing users to remove and re-add
Marta: Also proposing contextual SSO label: instead of 'Require SSO' use 'SSO enforcement 0(Org-wide/Admins only)'. More explicit
Owen: Small copy nit: primary CTA currently 'Invite users' in drawer and 'Send invites' elsewhere. Standardize to 'Send invitations'
Priya: Keyboard: opening the accordion should move focus into the first interactive element inside it. Closing should return focus to the header
Caleb: Audit panel: when you open audit for a role, open as a side panel and highlight the role row briefly so users can correlate
Liz: Contrast: timestamps in side panel at 12px fail at small widths. Bump size or darken color to meet 4.5:1
Marta: Accessibility idea: when tokeniser runs, announce via aria-live: 'Parsed 14 emails, 2 invalid' after debounce
Owen: Dev note: store current filters/sort in query params so users can share the accordion state + open item
Priya: For mobile, accordion hit target must be >=44px and should not rely on hover affordances
Caleb: Duplicate emails: collapse into one token with a small "x2" badge and an option to expand to see duplicates
Liz: Focus outline regression spotted in Chrome when compact rows enabled. Filing ENG-13670 with repro steps
ux-bot: Checklist updated: accordion-a11y, invite-tokeniser, sso-labels, audit-sidepanel-highlight
Marta: Action items: Priya will add aria attributes to Figma, Owen will unify CTA copy, Caleb will spec token errors UX, Liz will follow up on ENG-13670
Priya: I'll also run a keyboard + NVDA pass once a prototype is in staging
Marta: Thanks all :thumbsup:
